captions.detailed: A photography continuous ring light mounted on a counterbalanced boom arm. The assembly features a heavy, dark cylindrical base supporting a vertical post, which connects via a swivel joint to a horizontal boom arm. The rear of the boom arm holds cylindrical counterweights, while the front end suspends a rectangular U-shaped yoke. The ring light itself, with a dark outer casing and a bright white circular diffuser, is mounted inside this yoke and can tilt on a horizontal axis.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a photography ring light on a counterbalanced boom arm. The model should include a weighted cylindrical base, a vertical support post, a horizontal boom arm with counterweights at one end, and a rectangular yoke holding a circular ring light with a distinct white diffuser ring, allowing for adjustable tilt.
captions.factory: Construct the base using a low, wide cylinder and attach a tall vertical cylinder for the post. Build the boom arm using a horizontal rectangular bar, adding a series of thicker cylinders at the rear end to represent the counterweights. Create the mounting yoke from a horizontal rectangular bar joined with two vertical side brackets. Model the ring light by extruding concentric circles to form the casing, and a slightly recessed concentric ring with a white material for the diffuser. Assemble the parts using revolute joints at the post-to-boom connection and the yoke-to-ring-light connection.
